description: Well-known localities that OpenStreetMap records only as a street, landmark or campsite rather than as a place node. The build script (scripts/geo/buildLocalityIndex.js) resolves each entry to the named OSM feature below, takes that feature's position, and assigns municipality and district from the OSM boundaries exactly like any other place. Nothing here names a district, municipality or courier destination by hand. Add an entry only when a customer-familiar place name is missing from the generated index.
